`` Anyone has heard of the Dragons, western and eastern. But now we found a extraordinary variant of them.'' 
 
 `` What are they called?'' 
 
 `` Dracolords.'' 
 
 `` Dracolords?'' 
 
 `` Yeah.'' 
 
 `` What is so unique about these Dracolords?'' 
 
 `` This is recent news, so i do n't know everything.'' 
 
 `` Alright doc tell me what you know.'' 
 
 `` Reportedly these Dracolords are outright capable of turning in ordinary humans, indistinguishable, aside from those medieval helmets they are fond of wearing.'' 
 
 `` That's it?'' 
 
 `` They also could transform in full-blooded dragons, and here is a strange fact: it seems that Dracolords are outright immune to reality warping.'' 
 
 `` Immune to reality warping?'' 
 
 `` Yeah, i witnessed a reality warper being attacked by that Dracolord, tried to erase said creature from existence.'' 
 
 `` And i guess what happened next'' 
 
 `` It seems that they are n't fond of Reality warpers, tore that guy to shreds. Good thing i'm not a reality warper.'' 
 
 `` Also a female Dracolord is called: A Dracolady.'' 
 
 `` That's it? Do n't you have more info?'' 
 
 `` One last thing though, they are secretive. They like their privacy. And if said privacy is disturbed, they will kill the offender.'' 
 
 `` Allright, i'm of to go!'' 
 
 `` Wait, what are you gon na do? Where are you going?'' 
 
 `` I'm gon na find one of those Dracolords of course.'' 
 
 `` * facepalm * ``
retelling:
Perspective: The Inquirer/Listener

   Across the table, a figure cloaked in an air of mystery sat, their eyes gleaming with curiosity. The Doc/Narrator, an old friend, was regaling tales of new and extraordinary creatures - these Dracolords, as they were called. I couldn't help but feel the rush of excitement that coursed through me at each word spoken about these shapeshifting beings who could disguise themselves as humans, donning medieval helmets no less.

But it wasn't just their ability to blend in amongst us mortals that captivated my attention; it was their other form - the terrifying dragon aspect they transformed into. And yet, more astounding still was the fact that these Dracolords were immune to reality warping. The very thought of such a creature boggled the mind, leaving me craving to know more.

As my friend continued sharing what little was known about these elusive beings, I asked questions - questions about their behavior, their motivations, and why they guarded their privacy so fiercely. Each query was met with a response that only fueled my desire to understand them better. Yet, the Doc's tone grew increasingly exasperated as our conversation continued, it seemed this pursuit of knowledge was not shared by all.

Determined to unearth the truth about these enigmatic beings, I couldn't help but feel a twinge of frustration at my friend's reluctance to pursue the matter further. But that only served to reinforce my resolve - I would find a Dracolord and unravel the secrets they guarded so jealously.

The conversation ended there, but in my mind, it was just beginning. The pursuit of knowledge is a relentless beast, one that cannot be tamed by exasperation or fear. And as I walked away from our meeting, I felt certain that eventually, I would stand face-to-face with one of these elusive Dracolords and uncover the truth behind their enigmatic existence.
